validation.capture_local_field_reuse: Source regression at 70d35b84dae4e840e8cc881c35ef45014c604284 covers bitwise nodal/DG0 equivalence, one H_ex/H_ext read per batch, same-step re-read, and provider failure. A managed full-Zarr OFF/ON pair preserved both frames, all four fields, 15 table columns, terminal m/torque and the full schedule. The trace comparison observed 346 to 262 D2H events in the 209192 B bin and cudaMemcpy2D 252 to 168; the 8 B bin increased by 90 events (+720 B). The earlier packed ON revision lacked the independent residual fix, so aggregate byte deltas are not attributed solely to this cache. No time or speedup claim is qualified.
